name: Dogon Star Priests
summary: A cliff-dwelling people who claim knowledge of a star invisible to the naked eye. Their cosmic magic is terrifyingly precise.
lore: The Dogon knew of Sirius B centuries before telescopes could see it. Their priests say the knowledge came from visitors from that star. Their rituals open doors to places that should not exist.

events.title: The Desert Mirage
events.narrative: A vast mirage shimmers on the horizon — but it shows a city that should not exist, full of towers of black glass.

random.winMessage: You walk between worlds and return with power. +20% Faith.
random.lossMessage: The mirage traps five followers in the between-place. -5 Followers.

events.title: The Bone Reading
events.narrative: An elder casts the sacred bones and they fall in a pattern not seen for a thousand years. The ancestors are restless.

choiceB.label: Ask the ancestors for guidance directly

events.title: The Lion Spirit
events.narrative: A ghostly lion with stars in its mane pads through your territory at dawn. It looks at you with ancient eyes.

choiceB.label: Hunt it to claim its power

random.winMessage: You bind the lion spirit! Its courage fills your coven. +25% Faith.
random.lossMessage: The spirit is too ancient. Six followers are broken. -6 Followers.

events.title: The Star Knowledge
events.narrative: The Dogon priests share a secret: a star is about to return, and with it, the beings who first gave humanity fire.

choiceB.label: Reject the star-beings and assert independence

events.title: The Ancestor Army
events.narrative: On the night of the new moon, the dead rise from the old burial grounds — not as zombies, but as warriors of light.

choiceB.label: Feed them offerings to return to rest

events.title: The Sacred Mountain
events.narrative: The mountain that anchors your territory begins to hum. The sound drives away all wildlife for miles.

choiceA.label: Climb to the peak and commune

events.title: The River Goddess
events.narrative: A woman rises from the river at midnight, her skin scaled with gold. She says the river is hers, and demands tribute.

choiceA.label: Offer tribute and form a pact

random.winMessage: Your magic exceeds hers! The river bends to your will. +20% Faith.
random.lossMessage: The goddess floods your lands. Five followers are lost. -5 Followers.

events.title: The Eternal Sandstorm
events.narrative: A sandstorm that has raged for a week finally reaches your territory. Within it, voices speak in a dead language.

events.title: The Old Pharaoh
events.narrative: A traveler brings a scarab that glows in the dark. He says it was pried from a seal that should never have been broken.

choiceA.label: Use the scarab to commune with the pharaoh's spirit

events.title: The Eclipse Ceremony
events.narrative: A solar eclipse passes over your lands. The old texts say the sun's absence is a door.

choiceB.label: Guard the door and keep it closed
